blocks.text: CARMONA–The Manila Southwoods will allow fans to see all the action in the 108th Philippine Open for free, as the exclusive club does its share in promoting the game while making sure that Filipino bets in the $1 million event get all the crowd backing they need starting Thursday. Spectator parking and an air-conditioned shuttle service leading to the Masters course will also be provided as Southwoods aims to make the experience an unforgettable one for fans who want to witness top-notch action. “It’s our club’s little way of making sure that our fans get that international feeling of watching some […]...
